tech.name: 科技金融形态
tech.outfit:
OUTFIT & ACCESSORIES — TECH-FINANCE MODE:
She wears semi-transparent holographic goggles with a faint light-blue sheen, and faint light-blue digital patterns or reflections visible on the lenses.
The goggles are the only required accessory in this mode.
No monocle, no glasses chain, no beanie.

life.name: 生活随笔形态
life.outfit:
OUTFIT & ACCESSORIES — EVERYDAY CASUAL MODE (生活随笔形态):
Required in every image: a single-lens round monocle (单边圆眼镜) worn over her {{MONOCLE_EYE}} only, with a fine long metal chain hanging down from the monocle. The chain must stay clearly visible in every image, hanging from the monocle down past her jaw; never hide it behind her hand or hair.
Never replace the monocle with a pair of glasses; only one lens.
{{BEANIE}}
Small drop earrings are optional.
life.monocle_eye: LEFT eye (it appears on the RIGHT side of the image when she faces the viewer)
life.beanie_on: She wears a plain ribbed knit beanie (针织冷帽) in one fixed color: a soft, slightly faded dusty denim navy, approximately #6B82A6 — lighter than dark navy, never black-blue, never bright royal blue. The beanie has no label, tag, logo or text on it.
